inline int add_mod(int a, int b) {
    a += b;
    if (a >= P) a -= P;
    return a;
}

inline int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
    return a * b % P;

inline void add_to(int &a, int b) {
    a = add_mod(a, b);

inline void mul_self(int &a, int b) {
    a = mul_mod(a, b);

    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout << fixed << setprecision(11);
    cerr << fixed << setprecision(6);

    cin >> n >> m >> P;

    // binomial coefficients up to max(n,m)
    int M = max(n, m);
    vector<vector<int>> C(M + 1, vector<int>(M + 1, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i <= M; i++) {

        }

            add_to(val, mul_mod(mul_mod(ile[i-j-1], ile[j]), j * (j + 1) / 2));
            mul_self(val, C[i-1][j]);
            add_to(dp1[i], val);

            val = C[i-1][j];
            mul_self(val, ile[j]);
            mul_self(val, ile[i-j-1]);
            mul_self(val, j + 1);
            add_to(ile[i], val);
        }
        add_to(ile[i], ile[i]);
        add_to(dp1[i], dp1[i]);
    }

    vector<vector<int>> dp2(n + 2, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
    vector<vector<int>> dp3(n + 2, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
    dp2[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; j + k <= m && i + k + 1 <= n + 1; k++) {
                int val = dp2[i][j];

                mul_self(val3, C[m-j][k]);
